messages:
Lena (docs): Pushed a small PR to rename 'tier bucket' -> 'usage tier label' on the billing UI and to include a compact migration snippet showing header-based metering. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6601
Ravi (billing): Curious if any metric names change or it's purely a label/UI change?
Lena (docs): Purely UI + docs. Backend meter remains 'inference_unit'. Adding mapping note: inference_units = ceil(tokens/128).
Nora (devex): Can you paste the Go and Ruby snippets here? I'll sanity check for idiomatic code.
Lena (docs): Go and Ruby examples below (minimal):
```go
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer(body))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+key)
req.Header.Set("x-rw-meter", "inference_unit")
http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
```
```ruby
# Ruby Net::HTTP example
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{key}"
req['x-rw-meter'] = 'inference_unit'
res = Net::HTTP.start(...){|http| http.request(req)}
```
Kai (support): Please add a 2-line customer-ready blurb clarifying that usage_tier on dashboard groups billing bands and is not the same as per-second rate limit.
Ravi (billing): Also clarify burst credits: they offset cumulative IU billing but don't alter the enforced RPS limit.
Lena (docs): Added both notes and a tiny pseudo-query for the dashboard grouping by usage_tier. Preview build: https://deploy.preview.redwood.company/docs/billing/usage-tier-labels :ok_hand:
PreviewerBot: Preview deploy succeeded, link above.
Nora (devex): LGTM; suggested minor formatting nit for code blocks, pushed.
Kai (support): Great, merging after CI. I'll copy the customer blurb into support snippets.
Lena (docs): Thanks everyone — will backport to v1.9 and add a changelog entry.
